name: chiefman
description: Skills for staying the architect while an agent does the work. You do the thinking; the agent runs in the loop.

skills.name: plain-english
skills.description: Foundation voice skill. High-school level language, short sentences, no AI tells. Every other skill layers on top.

skills.name: explain
skills.description: Understanding mode. Finds the one piece you are missing and fills only that, one idea per reply, built on what you already know.

skills.name: goal-alignment
skills.description: Co-write a PIV brief, settle the decisions, prove prerequisites, then hand the agent a self-correcting loop of fast checks; the end-to-end check follows.

skills.name: chief
skills.description: Run many Claude Code sessions at once. One chief routes work between tmux-hosted boxes and background runners, coordinates through a ledger, brings you one thing at a time, and on request gives the drill-down: a short numbered list of what needs you. chiefman, the Mac app, is its visual front end.

skills.name: drill-down
skills.description: The numbered list of what is in flight, read live: first what needs you now with the exact words that unblock it, answered by number. Over all boxes in the chief, one box's own work anywhere else.
